applies_to: Neptronic SKG4 gas-fired steam humidifiers with up to four humidifier modules.
summary: The SKG4 is a natural gas or propane fired steam humidifier with BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP on its controller. The object list covers system control sources and network inputs plus per-module (1-4) state, request, alarm, burner, service and water level objects.
notes: Objects and their writable properties are taken from the guide's 'W?' column; Present_Value writable means the BMS can change it.
Units follow the BACnet Server Units setting (Metric or Imperial).
Module 2-4 objects only apply to multi-module units.
MSV 127 is printed as NSV.127 in the guide; it is a multi-state value.

source.title: SKG4 Gas Fired Humidifier BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Select a network control profile (MSV 33) or demand source, write the demand to AV 141 or a room RH reading to AV 109 with setpoint AV 110, and switch the system with MSV 60. Monitor per-module state and alarm MSVs plus BV 104 for network control health.

integration.enable: MSV 60 System Power State is writable (1 = Off, 2 = On). The control source follows MSV 33 Control Profile (ExternNetwork / InternNetwork for BMS control) or the individual source MSVs with the Custom profile.
integration.heartbeat: AV 248 Network Timeout (1-900 s) sets how long the humidifier tolerates loss of BACnet control communication before stopping; BV 104 Network Control State reports 1 = Fault.
integration.remote_sensors: With the room RH source on Network write room RH to AV 109 and setpoints to AV 110-112 (occupied/unoccupied/vacant); write the supply high limit reading to AV 125 and setpoint AV 126. A direct network demand goes to AV 141 and a network high limit to AV 142.
setup: MS/TP MAC defaults to 1 (000-254; 128-254 are non-token-passing slaves); baud rate auto-detects (Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); Max_Master 127.
Device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC (153001 out of the box) and can be changed from the menu or by writing Device Object_Identifier.
BACnet IP uses UDP 47808 (0xBAC0) by default.
Network/communication settings are in the controller's Integration menu (password 5544); power-cycle after connecting to the network.
Reinitialize Device (warm/cold reset) over BACnet uses the password 'nep'.
gotchas: MSV 'BACnet Server List Mode' chooses which objects are published (Integrator, Advanced, Factory); objects marked Advanced in the guide, such as the program objects, only show in Advanced mode.
Writing Out_of_Service = True disconnects an object from its physical input so the Present_Value can be overwritten; remember to set it back.
The unit signals alarms through object values only; it does not send BACnet event notifications, so poll or use COV.
COV subscriptions are lost on a power cycle.
Per-module request MSVs (64, 67, 70, 73) act on one module; MSV 61 acts on the whole system.
